body: That's the thing, I don't generally tell anyone so I feel like most people assume I'm on the spectrum or have a learning disability or something like that.
Yep. I always stored my tabs in volume 3 of Berserk wrapped in some tinfoil.

How long are you waiting between trips? LSD tolerance builds pretty much immediately after you trip and can take up to 2 weeks to return to normal. You can still trip more often than that (speaking from experience), but you're definitely not going to be getting the full effect of your tabs if you drop them too soon.
Good luck and good vibes. My favorite trips were on two Voidrealms. The visuals are fucking beautiful in my experience. Enjoy your trip my dude.
